decisions.statement: With no argument the script writes the X config and runs the server in front.
The event node the script is told to bind exists before the X server starts.
Hotplug is off.
The named input device is the authority on the event node the X server reads input from.
The self-test exits 0 where every claim passed.
The self-test exits 1 where a claim did not pass.
The self-test exits 2 on a tool or setup error.
A claim says PASS or FAIL or DID-NOT-MEASURE.
DID-NOT-MEASURE is neither a PASS nor a FAIL.
A broken instrument reports DID-NOT-MEASURE rather than a broken substrate.
An assertion is read at the receiver and never from the injector's exit code.
Every count is a delta against a baseline taken immediately before the action.
The uinput injection runs only after an XTEST positive control has landed.
The root window is painted a solid color at startup.
X's own default root window is a two-color stipple weave.
The Wine frames are compared as a pixel count against a floor.
A blinking caret alone changes a few dozen pixels.
A software rasterizer named in GL_RENDERER is a FAIL.
An absent ICD reports DID-NOT-MEASURE rather than a FAIL.
A Wine prefix with no registry stops the run.
Xorg registers the named input device twice and refuses the second registration.
The first registration stays live and has every event the rig injects.

definition: the X server the rig runs and the acceptance saying the substrate works
